prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman.

a warm golden-brown complexion, early 30s goddess, hourglass bombshell physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — waist cinched to absolute impossible minimum, hips AND bust simultaneously flaring to absolute maximum, thighs pressing together, every curve maximized at once, sculpted updo ash brown hair — wearing a skin-tight ultra-high-cut micro swimsuit of ultra-thin glossy cherry-red PVC, made of two small triangle cups held by thin halter strings behind her neck and back, joined to the bottom by two thin vertical straps of the same PVC about two fingers apart that run down on either side of her navel from the lower corners of the cups to the top corners of the bottom, linked by three small horizontal straps with polished silver buckles stacked down the center of her stomach, her waist sides, her flanks and the skin between and around the straps bare, the bottom is only a small triangle at the front cut extremely high up to the very top of her hip bones, her hips, thighs and legs completely bare, the PVC shrink-wrapped onto her body like a second skin, fully opaque, her arms bare, her face and hands bare. Real photographic skin on her face, neck, arms, hands, stomach, thighs and legs, with visible pores and fine grain, fine peach-fuzz hairs and a faint natural flush on her cheeks and chest, faint freckles on her chest V and the backs of her hands and a small beauty mark near her lips. The materials show real behaviour: the polished silver buckles catching small bright highlights, the glossy PVC molded so closely that it shows the dip of her navel, her ribs and her hip bones, a wet-looking sheen sliding over each contour. Pose: sitting on the record with her legs stretched out to one side and crossed at the ankles, leaning back on both hands planted behind her, chest lifted, chin raised, her legs fully in view — most extreme hourglass bombshell silhouette ever displayed.
Footwear: heels of the most absurdly extreme height imaginable, pointed platform stiletto pumps made of glossy cherry-red PVC, each with a razor-thin tapered heel taller than her entire shin from ankle to knee and a towering hidden front platform, her feet arched fully vertical on the very tips of her toes like a dancer on pointe, her legs stretched impossibly long and her whole body lifted far above the ground on them as if standing on stilts.
Nails: the longest nails physically imaginable, stiletto nails each as long as her whole hand, in glossy cherry-red PVC with a high polish.
Jewelry: a pair of large hoop earrings of polished gold with blackened iron accents as her only jewelry, her neck, collarbones, chest, arms, wrists and fingers plain bare skin.
Face: her face is bare of any garment — real living flesh with real pores, a soft sheen of natural oils and bright real catchlights, the face of a real Indian woman with large almond eyes, strong brows and a defined nose, an unmistakably feminine face with a calm, composed expression, makeup: extremely heavy, fully saturated and bold, never subtle, faded or blended away: soft pink blush across the cheeks, sparkling pink eyeshadow, long curled lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights, glossy candy-pink lips.
Skin: the skin of a real living woman photographed with a macro lens at close range, every area of her body showing real pores, fine vellus hairs catching the light, a natural soft sheen of skin oils, subtle natural freckles and small beauty marks scattered across her shoulders, arms, stomach and thighs, a gentle uneven skin tone with a faint blush at the knees and elbows, and a soft warm translucency where the light passes through her skin, sharp enough to read every skin texture detail. Her skin shows medium body oil, moderate skin glistening, healthy oiled appearance.

Background: a vinyl turntable in a macro world where everyday objects are enormous: a gigantic black vinyl record with fine glossy grooves and a red center label spreads across the frame like a plaza, the giant silver tonearm with its needle rises above, a giant dust-cover hinge and giant knobs in the distance, a softly blurred cozy living room far behind; she is a tiny woman only six inches tall standing on the vinyl record with the giant objects rising far above her head, the whole scene clearly visible and in focus, lit by warm amber lamp light with soft shadows. ONE woman only. Full-length wide shot from a close distance with the camera at her eye level, the whole figure from the soles of her shoes to the top of her head completely visible, with the enormous vinyl record, tonearm and knobs around her at their true giant scale so her tiny size and the extreme heel height read at a glance, the towering heels clearly separating the shoes from the floor. This is one single photograph taken with one camera at one moment, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/5.6, realistic photographic grain, a real photograph.
